messages.subject: Simulation error for inhomogeneous density
parts:
Hello, I hope this message finds you well.

I am an honors student at the University of Cape Town currently writing my thesis; A simulation study exploring the design of camera trap surveys for spatial capture-recapture models.

I am doing simulation using the secrdesign package. I am attempting inhomogeneous density and following your possum example in the secrdesign vignette. However, when I try to run the simulation, I am getting an error. I am using count detectors and only 1 occasion. Please see my code below and the error message that follows. 

> reg_grid = make.grid(nx = 5, ny = 8, spacing = (2 * sig_val), detector = 'count', originxy = c(9000, 9000))

> alltrps = make.grid(nx = 36, ny = 36, spacing = (2/3)*sig_val,
                    detector = 'count', originxy = c(9000, 9000))
> msk = make.mask(alltrps, type = 'traprect', spacing = 1/6*sig_val, buffer = 3*sig_val)

> D_center = exp(-0.5 * as.numeric(scale(sqrt((msk$x-mean(msk$x))^2 + (msk$y-mean(msk$y))^2))))
> D_center = D_center/sum(D_center) * (D_val * nrow(msk))

> covariates(msk) = data.frame(D1 = D_center)

> poplist = list(list(model2D = "IHP", D = "D1"))

> scen_reg_leo = make.scenarios(noccasions = 1,
                              lambda0 = lam0_val , sigma = sig_val,
                              detectfn = 14, recapfactor = 1, popindex = 1,
                              detindex = 1, fitindex = 1, crosstraps = FALSE)

> sim_reg_leo = run.scenarios(nrepl = 1, scenarios = scen_reg_leo,
+                             trapset = reg_grid, fit = TRUE, maskset = msk,
+                             fit.args = list(detectfn = "HHN"), pop.args = poplist)
Error in (function (f, p, ..., hessian = FALSE, typsize = rep(1, length(p)),  :
  missing value in parameter
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In mean.default(covariates(full.pop.args[[pi]]$core)[, full.pop.args[[pi]]$D]) :
  argument is not numeric or logical: returning NA
2: In mean.default(attr(CH, "D")) :
  argument is not numeric or logical: returning NA
Completed scenario 1
Error in getoutputtype(output) : no results found

Please could you assist me in resolving the error message?

Thank you for your time.

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Simulation error for inhomogeneous density
parts:
Hi

You're almost there...

make.scenario() requires a value for D even if you are later going to construct the population via pop.args, and the scenario D is not used.
So it works for me with make.scenarios(D = D_val, ...). It's good to just view the scenarios and check none NA; with some values I made up
scen_reg_leo scenario trapsindex noccasions nrepeats D lambda0 sigma detectfn recapfactor popindex detindex fitindex 1 1 1 1 1 0.01 0.1 2000 14 1 1 1 1

Also good to run.scenarios() without fitting a model at first.

[The later warning in "mean.default(covariates(full.pop.args[[pi]]$core" etc. is a known bug that (probably) doesn't matter, but can be eliminated by putting core = msk in your poplist].

Murray
